items.title: 🤝 Jordan Firstman on his 'Club Kid' co-star bond
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
<article>Actor and filmmaker Jordan Firstman stars in "Club Kid" as a New York City club promoter whose life is upended when he discovers he has a son, played by Reggie Absolom.
 
The film, which also stars Cara Delevingne and Diego Calva, follows him on a journey of self-discovery.
 
"Club Kid" emerged as one of the surprise breakout titles at this year's Cannes Film Festival, reportedly sparking a bidding war among distributors that was ultimately won by A24.

items.title: Peru installs giant Pope Leo statue ahead of papal visit
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
<article>Peruvians installed a 46-foot statue of Pope Leo XIV in a park in Callao using a crane to lift its torso and head into place. Sculptor Rafael Gutierrez said it had a galvanized steel interior and a catalyzed nautical paint coating to protect it from sea salt and corrosion.
 
#pope #popeleo #religion #peru #statue</article>
